messages:
Ana: Quick thread for the 'Noir' dark-theme pass. Main asks: heatmap semantics, syntax contrast for long reads, and rename the theme toggle (users find 'Dim' unclear).
Ravi: Heatmap: current spectrum (purple->orange) confuses ordering in colorblind sims. Propose luminance-first ramp with a subtle chroma overlay for visual interest. Keep cell separators as 1px semi-opaque lines rather than textures.
Cole: Syntax: identifiers use saturated cyan — eyestrain in long sessions. Move ids to desaturated teal, keep bright cyan only for links/active. Also increase inline code bg contrast slightly to meet 4.5:1 for 13px.
Maya: Copy/accessibility: agree drop 'Dim' 1 copy to "Appearance: Light / Dark / System" and add aria-label "Toggle appearance". Add tooltip "Press T to toggle" plus a SR-only hint about contrast.
Ana: Perf note: avoid per-cell raster patterns on heatmaps. If we add subtle chroma, do it via a single composite pass or CSS overlays. Target <10ms extra paint on mid-tier mobile.
Ravi: I'll run deutan/protan sims and provide palette candidates (Viridis-like + warm-cool ramp) tomorrow. Also will check legend text sizes; if 12px fails, bump to 14px.
Cole: Posting small CSS token example to try in console: 
```css
:root{ --bg:#080A0C; --text:hsl(210 9% 88%); --muted:hsl(210 6% 66%); --id-teal:hsl(175 38% 58%); --link:#5EF0FF; --heat-low:hsl(210 60% 22%); --heat-mid:hsl(40 60% 46%); --heat-high:hsl(12 72% 54%); }
```
Maya: I'll update the Figma with two variants and add a short test plan: 1) contrast audit, 2) 5-person color-ordering task w/ sims, 3) perf paint measurements. design-bot: created THEME-5230 with links.
Ana: Plan: A/B behind flag to 5% for 2 weeks after perf checks. Sync Friday for final pick. :thumbsup:
